split_method: split-by-document; sha256(doc_id)[:8] % 100; train<80, val<90, test<100; deterministic, all chunks sharing a doc_id land in the same split (no chunk leakage across splits)
deduplication: content_hash = sha256(redacted_text); duplicate content_hash not re-inserted

retrieval.tokenizer: re.findall(r'\w+'), lowercased, English stopword removal (NOT the 291-token project tokenizer)

tokenizer_count: quantum_corpus.tokenize_count.count_tokens (exact prefix-pruned greedy match over the 291-token vocab)
notes: All manifest records (wormhole_experiment_manifest.json) landed in train/val; NONE in test. Therefore the test-only QA set draws gold_record_ids from ibm_job + repo + workload_csv test records only; no OTOC/manifest circuit questions are valid test-split gold questions.

QAP loose job records (extract_ibm_jobs_dir) carry a messy 'backend <bound method RuntimeJobV2.backend...>' field; clean zip-format job records (text LIKE '%backend ibm_%' AND NOT LIKE '%<bound%') are used for any backend-naming QA items.
This DB lives outside the repo (E:/Temp) so it is never uploaded to the public HF Space. The quantum corpus is private/local only.
